name: GhostInput
description: Themed wrapper around headless GhostInput. Same behavioral props plus size and block. Importing it loads the default stylesheet and scopes styles to this instance. Hand-written until GHO-13 generates manifests.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: Controlled value, forwarded to the unstyled GhostInput. Omit for uncontrolled mode.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial uncontrolled value, forwarded to the unstyled GhostInput.

props.name: type
props.description: Native text-like type, forwarded to the unstyled GhostInput.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Forwards native disabled semantics to the unstyled GhostInput.

props.name: readonly
props.description: Forwards native readonly semantics to the unstyled GhostInput.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Forwards consumer-owned validity to the unstyled GhostInput.

props.name: required
props.description: Forwards native required to the unstyled GhostInput.

props.name: size
props.description: Control size. The default omits data-size so CSS can treat a missing hook as md.

props.name: block
props.description: Stretch to the available inline size via data-block.

models.description: v-model binding for the input string.

exposed.name: element
exposed.description: The native input after mount; null before mount and after unmount. Delegates to the unstyled GhostInput.

exposed.name: focus
exposed.description: Focuses the native input when it is mounted and not disabled. Delegates to the unstyled GhostInput.

exposed.name: blur
exposed.description: Removes focus from the native input when it is mounted. Delegates to the unstyled GhostInput.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The native input inside the display:contents themed scope.

states.name: invalid
states.description: Consumer-owned invalid appearance. Wins data-state when overlapping disabled or readonly.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Unavailable appearance. Prefer the native disabled attribute when both apply.

states.name: readonly
states.description: Read-only appearance. Omitted while invalid or disabled.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-focus-ring-color
cssProperties.description: Outer color of the two-color keyboard focus indicator.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-focus-ring-contrast
cssProperties.description: Inner color of the two-color keyboard focus indicator.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-focus-ring-offset
cssProperties.description: Gap between the field edge and the focus ring.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-control-size-sm-min
cssProperties.description: Minimum block size for size sm.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-control-size-md-min
cssProperties.description: Minimum block size for size md.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-control-size-lg-min
cssProperties.description: Minimum block size for size lg.

keyboard.Tab: Move sequential focus into or out of the field when it is not disabled.
keyboard.Enter: May submit an ancestor form for text and search types.
